title: Barci Ya Wuce Lokaci
intro: Ka yi tunanin lokacin da aka yi shiru da gaskiya aka kuma farautar masu bi. Wata ƙaramar ƙungiya ta zaɓi ja da baya maimakon mika wuya, ta nemi mafaka a wurare mafi ban mamaki - wuri wanda zai zama wurin hutawarsu tsawon ƙarni da yawa ba tare da ƙirgawa ba. Lokacin da suka farka daga ƙarshe, duniya ta canza a kusa da su. Su waye waɗannan rayuka masu barci?
clues: Mu matasa ne da ke zaune a wani tsohon birni.
Al'ummarmu ta nemi mu yi ibada tare da su, amma muka ƙi.
Mun gudu daga birnin don neman mafaka daga waɗanda ke adawa da imaninmu.
Wani abokin tarayya mai ƙafafu huɗu ya tsaya a ƙofar maɓoyarmu.
Allah ya sa mun yi barci na tsawon shekaru ɗari uku da tara.
Da muka farka daga barci, birninmu da a da ake tsananta mana ya rungumi imani.

identity.label: Su waye Mu?
options: Ashab al-Kahf (Mutanen Kogo)
Ashab al-Fil (Rundunar Giwa)
Ashab al-Ukhdud (Asahabban Madatsar Ruwa)
Hawariyyun (Almajiran Isa)
Yajuj wa Majuj (Gog and Magog)

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Mun koma cikin kogo muka yi barci tsawon ƙarni da yawa
An cece mu daga wuta mai ci
Wani babban kifi ya haɗiye mu
An jarabce mu da raƙumi mai ban mamaki
An ba mu alamomi guda tara bayyanannu
trial.answer: Mun koma cikin kogo muka yi barci tsawon ƙarni da yawa

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Kogo mai zurfi a cikin tsaunuka
Jirgin ruwa a kan teku mai buɗewa
Babban gini da ya kai sama
Lambun da aka raba tsakanin abokan hamayya biyu
Katanga ta ƙarfe da tagulla
location.answer: Kogo mai zurfi a cikin tsaunuka

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Mun farka muka ga birninmu ya koma ga imani
Wuta mai ci ta yi sanyi kuma ta kasance cikin kwanciyar hankali
An nutsar da rundunar abokan gaba a cikin teku
Tsuntsaye ɗauke da duwatsu sun halaka abokin gaba
Wani babban kifi ya sallame mu zuwa bakin teku
outcome.answer: Mun farka muka ga birninmu ya koma ga imani

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
